Q1: What should this heal change, given that the failing conflicted path in the consumer PR is unknown and every rejected case must still fail closed?
Choices:
A) Diagnostics only. Keep `sandbox_path_unsupported`, but have `check_paths` write a path-free category for each rejection (`symlink`, `unreportable_name`, `non_regular`, `unreadable`), plus `report_unavailable` when the path list or report fails. Report the categories and their counts when the resolver fails. Add a regression test in `tests/test_review_conflict_resolve_sandbox_only.py` for each category; on today's code the test sees only the bare `unsafe` entry, so it fails. (RECOMMENDED)
B) A, plus treat plain regular files with an unreportable name (spaces, `@`, non-ASCII, too long) as host-only. The resolver would fail with `sandbox_path_host_only` and a count, without printing the name, and the new token would be added to `NON_RETRYABLE_FAILURE_REASONS`. Symlinks and non-regular entries would stay `sandbox_path_unsupported`.
C) File no code fix. Close this heal issue as needing a manual merge of the consumer PR, since every possible cause already fails closed and needs a human.
**Note:** C cannot be combined with any Q2 choice. It also does not meet the issue's constraint that the fix must include a regression test.
Q2: Where should the new path-free category appear?
Choices:
A) Add `category=<c> count=<n>` to the existing `AI_ENGINE_FALLBACK role=CONFLICT_RESOLVER ...` stderr line, which already reaches the failure-evidence tail. Leave the `::error::Conflict resolver isolation unavailable (reason=...)` line unchanged, so the heal fingerprint and this lineage stay continuous. (RECOMMENDED)
B) Add the category to the `::error::` line itself, so the failure comment's "First error" shows it. This changes the error signature, so later failures will start a new heal lineage instead of escalating this one at generation 3.
C) Both: put it on the `AI_ENGINE_FALLBACK` line and add a separate new `::error::` line after the existing one.
**Note:** B and C start a new heal lineage for this failure.
